bio: You get to this restaurant, which is located in a pretty little courtyard in Erfurt's old town via Johannesstraße. In a cosy atmosphere, diners tuck into Mediterranean-inspired cuisine that draws on flavours from all over the world. The menu features dishes such as Ricotta, truffle, pea, Serrano, Salsiccia, capers, sugar snap pea or Fjord trout, grape, risotto, truffle....
